title: Focused Village Golems
description: Village-spawned iron golems will only attack mobs that are threats to villagers
body:
This mod makes village-spawned iron golems ignore non-threats to villagers, such as spiders and skeletons. Likewise, non-threats to villagers will also ignore these golems.

This is useful for helping village iron golems from dying so early.

Attacking behaviors between player-made iron golems and other mobs are not affected by this mod.

Note:
Iron golems spawned through commands are not considered player-made. There was no easy fix for me to do this. I might attempt to correct this if there is enough support.
